description: An Obsidian-like Live Preview Markdown editor for VS Code with ordinary Markdown as the source of truth.
configuration.title: Markdown Live Editor
Development-only ATOK layer-isolation mode. `raw-cm6` is local CodeMirror only; `markdown` adds the Markdown language; `sync` adds project document sync; `preview` adds live preview and the custom Save/Undo/Redo keymap. Diagnostic modes never constitute a release configuration.
configuration.customCss.markdownDescript: Optional User Settings literal CSS applied after the built-in Live Editor style. `@import`, `url()`, external resources, and CSS larger than 64 KiB are rejected. A trusted owning workspace may additionally provide `.vscode/markdown-live-editor.css`.
